title: Your Name
comment: An absolute masterpiece of animation, storytelling, and emotional connection. The music by RADWIMPS is unforgettable.

title: Spirited Away
comment: A breathtaking fantasy adventure that is beautiful, imaginative, and deeply nostalgic. Miyazaki's world-building at its peak.

title: Interstellar
comment: A stellar journey through space and time that captures human emotion, science, and Hans Zimmer's pipe organ score in a spectacular way.
